note: Signature: terror and the grave. Only hero with fear, phase, zone, drain, root and stampede. Ghost clips in their own palette OBJ:7 (a fixed slot): Death = dissolve, ExtraPose00 = rising from the ground.

passives.name: Oathbreakers
passives.text: Arrows pass through the dead: +2 melee and +3 missile armor per level.

passives.name: Grey Host
passives.text: +5 max health and +1 health regeneration per level.

passives.name: Cold Blades
passives.text: +1 Strength and +2% critical chance per level.

passives.name: Already Dead
passives.text: Nothing frightens the dead: +10% fear resistance and +1 Courage per level.

passives.name: Hollow Voices
passives.text: +5 max Spirit and +1 Spirit regeneration per level.

passives.name: Debt of Souls
passives.text: Each kill pays the oath: +2 health and +1 Spirit per kill per level.

passives.name: Isildur's Curse
passives.text: Below a quarter health they hit 3 harder per level.

skills.name: Terror of the Dead
skills.text: The dead wail: foes around take {amount} and flee in terror for {seconds}s.

skills.name: Pass Through
skills.text: Turns to mist for {seconds}s: no harm can touch him, and foes he passes through take {amount} and slow.

skills.name: Grave Mist
skills.text: A cold fog lingers {seconds}s where he stands: foes in it take {amount} each second and slow.

skills.name: Soul Harvest
skills.text: For {seconds}s the life of every foe near him bleeds into him: {amount} a pulse, he heals 60% of it.

skills.name: Grasp of the Dead
skills.text: The dead rise and hold foes around in place for {seconds}s, {amount} damage. They can still swing.

skills.name: The Dead Sweep the Field
skills.text: The grey host surges past him and sweeps all before it: {amount} damage and a stun to each foe.
